title: Nash Flat 615
description:
Nashvilles finest one bedroom luxury rental unit located in Mid Town just moments away from the Parthenon, Vanderbilt University and 10 mins from Broadway!

The space
This one bedroom luxury apartment offers the perfect blend of comfortable sophistication…

This unit is wheelchair friendly and perfect for anyone looking to experience Nashville to its fullest! Just a few blocks from the Parthenon and walking distance to Centennial Park, Vanderbilt University, Vanderbilt Medical, Centennial Hospital, and the cities vibrant entertainment scene!

With just a 10 minute car ride to Broadway, getting your party on will be no issue! 

Enjoy walking distance food options such as Maggiano’s, Bellagio Pizza and Subs, J Alexander’s, Chipotle, Honey Baked Ham, Subway, Great American cookies, Tazikis, Ted’s Montana Grill and 51st Deli!

(There’s also a CVS, GNC and so much more down the street)

Guest access
As an honored guest, you have access to the gym, pool and business center at The Odyssey.

Other things to note
Please note that at the time of photography, the fridge and washing machine were not yet installed. Rest assured all of the amenities listed are up and running!
